SIGNALS.name: Trecopo
SIGNALS.summary: A post says Mistral released the weights of Mistral Large 4, a 1T-parameter model with 52B active, on Hugging Face on October 29, after a public preview on October 6.

SIGNALS.name: AppleInsider
SIGNALS.summary: AppleInsider shares a hands-on look at the iOS 27.3 beta, covering Safari, Siri AI and vertical tabs.

SIGNALS.name: Shruti
SIGNALS.summary: Sarvam released an open model called Prism, built on its 105B model, that answers fixed-option questions such as approve or reject in about 44 milliseconds.

SIGNALS.name: Anthropic
SIGNALS.summary: Anthropic introduces FlashProve, research on provable inference that lets developers check whether a response really came from a given AI model.

SIGNALS.name: ClaudeDevs
SIGNALS.summary: Users can now auto-connect plugins when they log in to Claude, for MCP servers that accept Claude as a trusted issuer, so no re-authorizing is needed.

SIGNALS.name: Vectorize
SIGNALS.summary: Vectorize introduces Hindsight Models, saying its memory is now 2.5x cheaper and 2x faster; weights are open on Hugging Face or hosted via an API.

SIGNALS.name: Pankaj Kumar
SIGNALS.summary: Claims GPT-6.2 Astra is routing on some accounts with a new checkpoint and produces strong SVG output. Unconfirmed by OpenAI.

SIGNALS.name: MTS
SIGNALS.summary: SemiAnalysis built GDPx, a benchmark of 206 multi-step tasks in 11 fields such as chip design and biology. The best model scores 12%, with Claude Opus 5.5 on top.

SIGNALS.name: AGTP
SIGNALS.summary: At ADIPEC in Abu Dhabi, Sam Altman said the internal model behind OpenAI's Navier-Stokes result is the next GPT, due to be released soon.
